Now is this realistic? It would be tough and there's a lot of ways it could go wrong, but the at the end of the day, game devs have to work to protect themselves and their medium and they will not be able to do that as individuals.

I think about this often. Years ago I'd get excited about new software or apps and their potential but not anymore. I go out of my way to find good open source projects to replace commercial solutions. That's not to say I won't pay for software, just that I'd sooner support indie devs.
